convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'MAOscillatorHist' and two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and money management. Custom smoothing methods beyond built-in MT5 indicators.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - time shift in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

long.left: MAOscillatorHist[2] > MAOscillatorHist[1] (histogram rising from bar+2 to bar+1)
long.right: MAOscillatorHist[1] < MAOscillatorHist[0] (histogram peak: bar+1 below bar+0, i.e. momentum decelerating after rise)

short.left: MAOscillatorHist[2] < MAOscillatorHist[1] (histogram falling from bar+2 to bar+1)
short.right: MAOscillatorHist[1] > MAOscillatorHist[0] (histogram trough: bar+1 above bar+0, i.e. momentum decelerating after fall)

other_exits: Signal-based close: BUY_Close triggered when histogram transitions from rising (Ind[2]>Ind[1]) to falling, SELL_Close triggered when histogram transitions from falling (Ind[2]<Ind[1]) to rising

params.MMMode: LOT (default) - mode switches between FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE, LOT

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot (MM value=lot size), FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of margin/balance (MM value=fraction 0.1=10%). When MMMode=LOT, MM=0.1 means 0.1 lots; otherwise MM=0.1 means 10% of selected base.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses a 3-bar histogram momentum pattern: long enters when histogram was rising (bar+2 > bar+1) but showing deceleration (bar+1 < bar+0) - a momentum peak/divergence signal. Short enters on the inverse pattern. The gate flags BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose control which signal directions are active. SignalBar input allows selecting which bar offset to read from (default=1, meaning signals calculated on the previous closed bar). Uses CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh for the underlying custom smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA).
python_conversion_notes: The MAOscillatorHist custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it computes a dual-smoothing oscillator using two independent MA smoothings (with 10 possible methods including JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with margin-aware lot sizing, signal-time tracking, and position management - these must be reimplemented. The 3-bar histogram comparison logic (Ind[2] vs Ind[1] vs Ind[0]) is the core signal and is straightforward to port. MMMode=LOT means fixed lot size; other modes compute lot size as fraction of free margin/balance. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so 1000/2000 points need digit-adjustment awareness for 5-digit brokers. The new-bar guard via CIsNewBar class must be replicated to prevent multiple entries per bar.
